basic_profile.bio: Aviation enthusiast and tech aficionado based in Brisbane, Australia. I work as a mechanical engineer with a focus on CNC machining. I'm passionate about flight simulation and spend my weekends exploring virtual skies with friends from around the globe. When I'm not flying or working, I enjoy tinkering with vintage Apple computers. I'm single and typically online in the evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Queensland. My expertise in CNC machining stems from both formal education and hands-on experience at my job. Additionally, I am self-taught in flight simulation and vintage computer restoration, often learning through online communities and forums.
